description.value: The Rooftop Patio is an open-air seasonal venue perched atop The Sticky Wicket, billed as Vancouver Island's largest pub, at 919 Douglas St in downtown Victoria. It offers an open-air barbeque grill, cocktails, and local beer, along with bookable outdoor volleyball courts. The venue hosts a busy schedule of live music and special events, making it a lively urban stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
